posts.meta_description:
42K likes, 232 comments - sjanaelise on August 24, 2026: "This audio makes me miss being immersed in containers of feminine energy. 🤍

As a retreat facilitator who has hosted MANY women’s retreats, I genuinely believe that gathering in sisterhood might just be one of the most healing spaces that exists ❤️🙏🏽🪽

There is something so powerful about being in a room where anything and everything is welcome - where you can soften, unravel, laugh, cry, feel, be witnessed, and be held without needing to explain or fix yourself. 

What is felt by one is felt by the collective. And somehow, in that shared space, we begin to transmute pain into wisdom, experience into growth, and heaviness into something we can learn and move through 🌀

The burdens we carry individually become lighter when they are held by our sisters.

There is medicine in being witnessed.
There is medicine in being understood.
There is medicine in remembering that you were never meant to carry it all alone.

Women gathering with women will always be a special kind of magic. 🌹✨🦋".

35K likes, 645 comments - sjanaelise on August 7, 2026: "I’m no medical professional but I personally believe exactly this and live by it as much as possible. 
Barefoot, sunrise and sunset light to charge up, I go to bed when the sun goes to bed, I haven’t touched regular (chemical!) sunscreens in years, I spend as much time as possible outside and at the beach - I usually expose myself between sunrise and 10am and 3pm to sunset, avoiding the harsh midday heat or cover up with organic cotton sarongs and/or sit in the shade of a tree. I do wear 100% natural mineral zinc on my face if i’m heading out in the middle of the day for a surf or hike, but I genuinely LOVE the sun so much and call myself solar powered. 
Throughout my life and also spiritual practices i’ve developed a beautiful relationship with Surya (Sun). I am outside in the morning sunlight right now as I write this! 🌞🙏🏽 and when we don’t cover ourselves is toxic chemical sunscreens and choose to live in rhythm with the sunlight and nature instead - healing portals open from the inside out. That’s my personal experience anyway. 🌞💛
I’m not here to try convince you to live the way I do - you’re a sovereign being and can make your own decisions.
This is simply what has been such a healing modality for me 💛
It’s also a process - it requires learning about sooo many other areas and things that are reacting negatively with the sun and causing us harm so choosing to not consume/use those either (for example: 
- consuming seed oils!
- Chemical skincare products and sunscreens - this means ANYTHING not entirely natural!!
- sunglasses (this is a whole other can of worms but the only time I wear sunglasses is when I am on a bike in Bali and it’s only to stop dust and bugs from blocking my vision - I do not want to block out the sun!!)
- choosing to only wear natural non-toxic fibres and clothing! 
- aligning my sleep times with the rise and fall of the sun
- choosing to be barefoot as much as possible (especially on grass/dirt, sand) (however, if you are barefoot and INSIDE all day and your floors are synthetic vinyl or anything un-natural you can also be absorbing that through your feet!
…just food for thought. 
What else did I".

133 likes, 5 comments - sjanaelise on October 8, 2026: "💗✨🦋🌀😝 i used to think it was a terrible thing to be “intimidating”. I thought it meant I was personally responsible for someone elses insecurity.
The older I get, the more I realize that taking up space, shining brightly and embodying your most wonderful whimsical self is actually one of the BEST things you can do for other women.
Why?
A) you’re giving PERMISSION to other women to also shine their light super fucking bright! 
And B) because if you trigger, or are intimidating or perceived as a “threat” by another woman, you haven’t dimmed her light at all. What you’ve done is illuminated the parts of her that she is yet to work with - shadow aspects yet to be integrated. 
You’ve unknowingly handed her an invitation to step into rafical self awareness and growth.
A conscious, heart-led woman willsee this for what it is, do the work and thank you for being a part of her initiation - fir being a direct mirror for her.
Your brightness will not be shunned or shamed or attempted to be dimmed by another empowered woman. 
She’ll know that you’re not in competition with one another, instead you’re different parts of the whole ❤️🌹💫".

posts.meta_description:
1,039 likes, 21 comments - sjanaelise on October 29, 2026: "Devotion and discipline are two sides of the same coin to me. The coin of dedication of the self, to the self, through the self. 
Devotion is the feminine offering/path. And discipline the masculine approach. Both equally valid in their own ways - both help us to keep showing up when things get challenging. But the intention and energy behind them is what truly fuels the fire in my belief.
If you’re a woman and you’re doing allll the things “right”. Aka you’re waking up early, meditating, moving your body, eating the healthy options etc and still feeling disappointed or stuck, I invite you to channel that energy toward yourself through means of DEVOTION over discipline.
What’s the difference? Intention. And the way it feels from INSIDE your body.
Aka discipline is linked to doing what you said you were going to do at all costs. White-knuckling through things. Force. Push. The more resistance you feel the more reason to keep pushing through.
And that may work for certain tasks and people - I see this being the trait that serves men well for motivation and drive.
But for women, the magic unfolds when we soften rather than harden. When we give ourselves the gift of grace and of space. Shifting the narrative from “I have to do this” to “I GET to do this”. And you’ll know because the energy is undeniable.  Palpable. 
It’ll feel like you’re DANCING rather than marching. Still to the rhythm, but the heartbeat is different. ❤️

Where are you on this scale? Honestly? There is no right or wrong. There is no better or worse. It’s just a matter of what energy you’ve been moving from and whether or not you’ve been moving consciously from that place or unconsciously. If we don’t like your truthful answer here, we can actively create change. And maybe all that is required to do is is to release the reins.
❤️".

724 likes, 32 comments - sjanaelise on October 22, 2026: "Gratitude is an elite frequency 🌀💗✨ Not because life is perfect and you have everything you could ever want, but because you’ve remembered to see the magic in what is already here 💫
The sun on your skin. The breath in your lungs. The body that carries you. The lessons that broke you open. The dreams that still set your soul on fire.
You can be d e e p l y grateful for your life AND still be hungry for more.
You can love where you’re at AND still be devoted to where you’re going.
That’s the magic of gratitude. You stop living in the energy of “i’ll be happy when…” and start becoming the woman who finds pleasure, beauty and abundance in the NOW.

And somehow, the more we appreciate what we have, the richer and richer life begins to feel 🌞❤️🙏🏽💫

Tell me one thing you’re grateful for today - I want to hear it!! ⤵️".

Embodiment. Self-worth. Receiving. Expansion.
Pleasure. Money. Love. Abundance.
It’s all ENERGY. 

Or are we still pretending wanting money makes us less spiritual? 👀😜

let yourself want more wild child 🐆💋
what are you learning to receive?".
